archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & EDITORIAL TRUST (Fintech Elite)

entry_surfaces./: split hero with kinetic masked headline + live interactive rate & consultation ticker left, live Quick EMI sandbox widget right; editorial trust badges beneath
entry_surfaces./calculators: full-bleed interactive financial suite with category tabs, dual-range sliders, live Recharts breakdown visualization, and Instant Consultation CTA
entry_surfaces./services: asymmetric bento grid of 6 core verticals (Business Loans, Home Loans, Mutual Funds & SIPs, Fixed Deposits, Life & Health Insurance, MSME Working Capital)
entry_surfaces./about: editorial storytelling timeline — vision, credibility metrics (₹500Cr+ Facilitated, 45+ Bank Partners), compliance governance, and advisory philosophy
entry_surfaces./founders: executive profile split grid with leadership bios, track record, investment pedigree, and direct meeting booking modal
entry_surfaces./how-it-works: interactive 4-stage facilitation pipeline (Consultation -> Bank Matching -> Documentation -> Fast Disbursement)
entry_surfaces./resources: categorized financial intelligence library with downloadable guides, tax calculators, glossary, and video insights
entry_surfaces./blog: curated editorial insights feed with featured cover story, filter chips, reading time, and lead capture newsletter
entry_surfaces./contact: split contact terminal with callback request wizard, Bangalore/Mumbai office locations, WhatsApp direct trigger, and phone lines
entry_surfaces./faqs: segmented accordion categorized into Loans, Investments, Insurance, and Process with live search bar

motion_and_interaction.reduced_motion: All motion variants MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion via standard framer-motion props

accessibility.color_contrast_min: 4.5:1 for normal body text, 3:1 for large display headers
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab order with visible ring-offset-2 ring-blue-500 indicators
accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, sliders, inputs, lead forms must have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='emi-slider-amount', data-testid='submit-callback-button', data-testid='nav-link-calculators')

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the theme in frontend/src/index.css using Tailwind v4. The default aesthetic is sleek obsidian-dark with royal blue (#2563EB) & electric cyan accents, designed for elite Indian financial facilitation.
Implement the 8 interactive financial calculators with real-time reactive sliders, number formatting with Rupee symbols, and dynamic Recharts pie/bar visualizations.
Ensure the hero has the exact headline 'Your Financial Goals. Our Guidance.' and positioning 'One Platform. Multiple Financial Solutions.'

Build out all required pages: Home (/), About Us (/about), Our Founders (/founders), Our Services (/services), Financial Tools & Calculators (/calculators), How It Works (/how-it-works), Resources & Financial Guides (/resources), Blog (/blog & /blog/:slug), FAQs (/faqs), Contact Us (/contact), Privacy Policy (/privacy), Terms of Service (/terms), and Admin Leads view (/admin).
Ensure lead generation forms (callback & detailed enquiry) connect to FastAPI backend /api/leads with immediate UI feedback via sonner toasts.
Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to every interactive component (buttons, inputs, sliders, navigation links, modals) for automated test verification.
